headline: The score hides on notched phones — no more
lede: Tidal Rush's HUD columns now ride the safe-area insets exactly like the arcade chrome does, so on a notched phone (and the TestFlight PWA) ARCADE, FEEDBACK, PAUSE and PADS never sit on your score — and at every width the HUD keeps the house 8px clearance from the pills.

notes.text: Both HUD columns compose calc(x + var(--sat/sal/sar)) — the same pattern nine other titles use; pills and HUD ride the notch together, gap constant at 11px.
The drive leg caught what the design pass missed: even at zero inset the score sat 3px under FEEDBACK (pill height is 29px, not the assumed 18) — the 8px law from #3365 now holds everywhere.
tidalcheck 236/236 with 41/41 mutants dead (two new: each column losing its inset composition), tidaldrive GREEN measuring real rects at inset 0 and sim-notch 59px.

look.text: GALAGA: bee is a shaped, flapping insect, not a flat gold brick
